_doc: Voices you can switch to live (console 'Voice' dropdown; live_bridge.py command voice_select). kind: rvc (trained model, like Karen) | seedvc (zero-shot from a short clip) | none (your own voice, in sync). Only one voice server runs on the GPU box at a time; switching unloads the old one (output muted ~10-25 s meanwhile). All voices are RVC now (girl/guy: own models, Karen's recipe, VCTK CC BY 4.0 - credit VCTK where the voices are used); Seed-VC remains for characters that only have a short clip (voice.kind seedvc). hf: the model's folder in the private artifacts repo (tools/rvc_live/get_voice.py --all).

girl.label: Generic girl (RVC)
girl.source: trained on VCTK speaker p300 (American female), CC BY 4.0 - attribution required: 'Voice model trained on the CSTR VCTK Corpus (University of Edinburgh), CC BY 4.0'; models/rvc/girl/README.txt

guy.label: Generic guy (RVC)
guy.source: trained on VCTK speaker p345 (American male), CC BY 4.0 - attribution required: 'Voice model trained on the CSTR VCTK Corpus (University of Edinburgh), CC BY 4.0'; models/rvc/guy/README.txt
